create_adaboost_classifier: create an AdaBoost classifier using SAMME algorithm for multi-class classification problems
build_adaboost_regressor: build an AdaBoost regressor using R2 algorithm for regression with linear, square, or exponential loss
test_adaboost_fit: test fitting an AdaBoost ensemble with sample weights on training data for classification or regression
review_adaboost_predict_proba: review AdaBoostClassifier predict_proba to compute class probabilities from weighted decision function scores
summarize_staged_predict: summarize staged_predict to yield ensemble predictions after each boosting iteration for monitoring
